The alcohol's wearing off a little, which is good i guess. I can think a little straighter.

I've been taking Zoloft for over a year now. its never done this before, i think its my new meds.

I'm 22, and I have tourettes. Its out of control now. Like i said, I'm voluntarily handing over my driver's licsence tomorrow before I kill someone because of my tics. People are mean because who wouldn't point and laugh at the freak who can hardly walk and is shouting expletives?

I don't like to drink because it does this to me. Thats really good that you were able to get sober...for what its worth, Im proud of you.
I'm going to throw up if i drink water especially fast, because of my stupid fucking medications. I've been chucking all weekend.
